notes.title: Harmonium released
notes.content:
To celebrate the release of Harmonium, we've decided to put it on sale until the 4th of April!
We hope you'll enjoy playing our game!

Welcome to Harmonium Point!

notes.title: Release postponed to the 28th of March
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Since we met a lot of people at Japan Tours Festival, we figured out new ways to improve your game experience with Harmonium!
That means that we'll have to postpone the release of Harmonium to the 28th of March. Sorry for the delay!
Thanks everyone for your feedbacks, you're awesome!
